view: View from curved stone seating down into Leptis Magna Roman theatre orchestra and ruined stage columns, pale Mediterranean band beyond, coherent semicircle and radial steps, no intact roof, no crowd.

eras.title: The theatre above the sea
eras.caption: Leptis Magna grew into a major Roman city with markets, public buildings and a harbour. Its excavated theatre preserves the relationship between the curved seating, stage and Mediterranean setting.
